what: Mutation checks ran against a red base and reported false coverage. A manifest check failed, but mutation checks still applied every mutant and reported each one killed — a result that looked like passing coverage but proved nothing, since a red base kills every mutant regardless of the guard being tested.
rule: Mutants only count against a base that is actually green.
fix: Enforcement: `integrate --mutants` refuses to start unless the unmutated tree passes all checks first; any non-test-failure exit (spawn error, usage error) is classified as `invalid`, never `killed`; `ship --require-section "Mutation check"` refuses outright when an integrated run's mutants came from a red base. Regression coverage is in `tests/lessons120-mutants.test.mjs`.
